title: Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Software Engineer to build and maintain backend services.

Responsibilities:
- Design, build and ship REST APIs used by web and mobile clients
- Write automated tests and participate in code reviews
- Work with product to refine requirements into deliverable increments

Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience with Python or Node.js
- Strong SQL and PostgreSQL knowledge
- Experience with Docker and CI/CD pipelines
- Bachelors degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

Benefits:
- Health insurance for you and dependents
- Annual learning budget
- Hybrid working

title: Senior React Developer
description:
Join our frontend team building customer facing products used across Pakistan.

Responsibilities:
- Own the frontend architecture for a major product area
- Mentor mid level engineers and set code quality standards
- Improve Core Web Vitals and accessibility

Requirements:
- 5+ years building production React applications
- Deep TypeScript knowledge
- Experience with Next.js and modern state management

Benefits:
- Provident fund
- Fuel allowance

title: Data Scientist
description:
Analyse product and transaction data to drive decisions.

Responsibilities:
- Build and evaluate predictive models
- Create dashboards for business stakeholders
- Partner with engineering to ship models to production

Requirements:
- 3+ years in a data science role
- Strong Python, pandas and scikit-learn
- SQL and data warehousing experience
- Masters degree preferred

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Build and deploy machine learning systems at scale.

Responsibilities:
- Productionise deep learning models
- Own model serving infrastructure and monitoring
- Evaluate LLM approaches for document understanding

Requirements:
- Strong PyTorch or TensorFlow experience
- Kubernetes and AWS experience
- 4+ years of relevant experience

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Own our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines.

Responsibilities:
- Manage Kubernetes clusters and Terraform modules
- Improve CI/CD reliability and deployment frequency
- Set up observability and on-call practices

Requirements:
- 3+ years with AWS or Azure
- Docker, Kubernetes and Terraform in production
- Linux administration

title: Cyber Security Analyst
description:
Protect our systems and customer data.

Responsibilities:
- Monitor SOC alerts and investigate incidents
- Run vulnerability assessments and penetration testing
- Maintain ISO 27001 compliance evidence

Requirements:
- 3+ years in information security
- Familiarity with SIEM tooling
- Relevant certification is a plus

title: Network Engineer
description:
Support and maintain enterprise network infrastructure.

Responsibilities:
- Configure routers, switches and firewalls
- Troubleshoot connectivity issues across branch offices

Requirements:
- CCNA certification
- 1+ years hands on networking experience

title: Financial Analyst
description:
Support financial planning and analysis for the group.

Responsibilities:
- Build financial models and budgets
- Prepare monthly management reporting
- Support investment appraisals

Requirements:
- ACCA, CA finalist or MBA Finance
- Advanced Excel and financial modeling
- 3+ years of experience

title: Accounts Officer
description:
Handle day to day accounting operations.

Responsibilities:
- Maintain accounts payable and receivable ledgers
- Prepare bank reconciliations
- Assist with monthly closing and tax filing

Requirements:
- B.Com or equivalent
- 1-2 years of accounting experience
- QuickBooks knowledge preferred

title: HR Business Partner
description:
Partner with business leaders on people strategy.

Responsibilities:
- Own recruitment and talent acquisition for your business unit
- Drive performance management cycles
- Advise managers on employee relations

Requirements:
- 5+ years in human resources
- Strong communication skills
- MBA HR preferred

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Grow our brand across digital channels.

Responsibilities:
- Plan and run paid social and search campaigns
- Manage SEO and content calendar
- Report on channel performance

Requirements:
- 1-2 years in digital marketing
- Hands on with Meta Ads and Google Ads
- Strong English writing

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Drive new business across enterprise accounts.

Responsibilities:
- Own the full sales cycle from prospecting to close
- Build relationships with key decision makers
- Achieve quarterly revenue targets

Requirements:
- 5+ years of B2B sales experience
- Proven quota attainment
- Excellent negotiation skills

title: Lecturer Computer Science
description:
Teach undergraduate computer science courses.

Responsibilities:
- Deliver lectures and labs for core CS subjects
- Supervise final year projects
- Contribute to curriculum development

Requirements:
- MS or MPhil in Computer Science
- HEC recognised degree
- Prior teaching experience preferred

title: Medical Officer
description:
Provide clinical care in our outpatient department.

Responsibilities:
- Assess and treat patients in OPD
- Maintain accurate clinical records
- Participate in on-call rota

Requirements:
- MBBS with valid PMDC registration
- House job completed
- 2+ years of clinical experience

title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
Support plant maintenance and reliability.

Responsibilities:
- Plan preventive maintenance schedules
- Troubleshoot rotating equipment failures
- Manage contractor work on site

Requirements:
- BE Mechanical Engineering, PEC registered
- 3+ years in a manufacturing environment
- AutoCAD proficiency

title: Civil Site Engineer
description:
Supervise construction activities on site.

Responsibilities:
- Supervise daily site activities and subcontractors
- Ensure work meets drawings and specifications
- Maintain daily progress reports

Requirements:
- BSc Civil Engineering, PEC registered
- 1-3 years of site experience
- AutoCAD

title: Legal Advisor
description:
Advise the business on commercial and regulatory matters.

Responsibilities:
- Draft and review commercial contracts
- Manage litigation with external counsel
- Advise on regulatory compliance

Requirements:
- LLB with bar licence
- 5+ years of corporate legal experience

title: Admin Officer
description:
Keep the office running smoothly.

Responsibilities:
- Manage office supplies and vendor coordination
- Maintain records and filing systems
- Support travel and event logistics

Requirements:
- Bachelors degree
- MS Office proficiency
- 1+ years administrative experience

title: Customer Support Representative
description:
Be the first point of contact for our customers.

Responsibilities:
- Handle inbound calls, chat and email queries
- Resolve issues within agreed service levels
- Escalate complex cases appropriately

Requirements:
- Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply
- Excellent spoken English and Urdu
- Willingness to work in rotating shifts

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
Design intuitive product experiences.

Responsibilities:
- Run discovery, wireframing and prototyping
- Maintain and grow the design system
- Partner with engineers through implementation

Requirements:
- 3+ years of product design experience
- Strong Figma skills
- Portfolio required

title: Supply Chain Officer
description:
Coordinate procurement and logistics operations.

Responsibilities:
- Raise and track purchase orders
- Coordinate with warehouse and transport partners
- Maintain inventory accuracy

Requirements:
- Bachelors in Supply Chain or Business
- 1-2 years of relevant experience
- ERP exposure preferred

title: Assistant Director (BPS-17)
description:
Applications are invited for the post of Assistant Director in BPS-17.

Responsibilities:
- Administrative and coordination duties as assigned
- Prepare summaries and official correspondence

Requirements:
- Second class Masters degree from an HEC recognised university
- Age limit 22 to 30 years
- Domicile of Punjab required

Applications must be submitted through the official portal. Last date: as notified.

title: Software Engineering Intern
description:
A six month paid internship for final year students and recent graduates.

Responsibilities:
- Work with a mentor on real product features
- Write tests and participate in code reviews

Requirements:
- Final year student or fresh graduate in CS or SE
- Familiarity with one programming language
- Fresh graduates welcome

title: Data Analyst Intern
description:
Learn analytics on real business data.

Responsibilities:
- Build reports and dashboards
- Clean and validate datasets

Requirements:
- Currently studying statistics, CS or a related field
- Excel and basic SQL

title: Remote Full Stack Developer
description:
Fully remote role open to candidates anywhere in Pakistan.

Responsibilities:
- Ship features across the stack
- Participate in architecture decisions

Requirements:
- 5+ years full stack experience
- React and Node.js or Python
- Strong written English for async collaboration

title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
Own automated test coverage for our platform.

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain Selenium and API test suites
- Integrate tests into CI pipelines

Requirements:
- 3+ years in quality assurance
- Test automation experience
- Strong SQL

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Create marketing and social media assets.

Responsibilities:
- Produce social media creatives and brand collateral
- Maintain brand consistency

Requirements:
- Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator
- 1+ years of experience
- Portfolio required

title: Content Writer
description:
Write clear content for web and campaigns.

Responsibilities:
- Write blog posts, landing pages and email copy
- Work with SEO to target relevant keywords

Requirements:
- Excellent English writing
- 1+ years content writing experience

title: Staff Nurse
description:
Deliver patient care on the medical ward.

Responsibilities:
- Provide direct patient care under supervision
- Maintain nursing records

Requirements:
- BScN or diploma in nursing
- Valid PNC registration

title: Electrical Engineer
description:
Lead electrical design and commissioning work.

Responsibilities:
- Own electrical design packages
- Supervise installation and commissioning

Requirements:
- BE Electrical, PEC registered
- 5+ years of experience
- AutoCAD and load calculations
